arxiv-2107-01619.title: Deep Edge-Aware Interactive Colorization against Color-Bleeding Effects
arxiv-2107-01619.creator: Eungyeup Kim *1 Sanghyeon Lee *1 Jeonghoon Park *1 Somi Choi 1
arxiv-2107-01619.description: Abstract Deep neural networks for automatic image colorization often suffer from the color-bleeding artifact, a problematic color spreading near the boundaries between adjacent objects. Such color-bleeding artifacts debase the reality of generated outputs, limiting the applicability of colorization models in practice.

arxiv-2312-07110.title: LLMs Perform Poorly at Concept Extraction in Cyber-security Research Literature
arxiv-2312-07110.creator: Maxime Würsch, Andrei Kucharavy, Dimitri Percia David, Alain Mermoud
arxiv-2312-07110.description: Abstract The cybersecurity landscape evolves rapidly and poses threats to organizations. To enhance resilience, one needs to track the latest developments and trends in the domain. It has been demonstrated that standard bibliometrics approaches show their limits in such a fast-evolving domain. For this purpose, we use large language models (LLMs) to extract relevant knowledge entities from cybersecurity-related texts.

arxiv-2408-09532.title: Deep Limit Model-free Prediction in Regression
arxiv-2408-09532.creator: Kejin Wu, Dimitris N. Politis
arxiv-2408-09532.description: Abstract In this paper, we provide a novel Model-free approach based on Deep Neural Network (DNN) to accomplish point prediction and prediction interval under a general regression setting. Usually, people rely on parametric or non-parametric models to bridge dependent and independent variables ( Y Y and X X ). However, this classical method relies heavily on the correct model specification.

arxiv-2412-00659.title: Linear Convergence Analysis of Single-loop Algorithm for Bilevel Optimization via Small-gain Theorem
arxiv-2412-00659.creator: Jianhui Li, Shi Pu, Jianqi Chen, Junfeng Wu
arxiv-2412-00659.description: Abstract Bilevel optimization has gained considerable attention due to its broad applicability across various fields. While several studies have investigated the convergence rates in the strongly-convex-strongly-convex (SC-SC) setting, no prior work has proven that a single-loop algorithm can achieve linear convergence.

arxiv-2507-13511.title: GraphTrafficGPT: Enhancing Traffic Management through Graph-Based AI Agent Coordination
arxiv-2507-13511.creator: Nabil Abdelaziz Ferhat Taleb 1 , Abdolazim Rezaei 1 , Raj Atulkumar Patel 1 , and Mehdi Sookhak 1
arxiv-2507-13511.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) offer significant promise for intelligent traffic management; however, current chain-based systems like TrafficGPT are hindered by sequential task execution, high token usage, and poor scalability, making them inefficient for complex, real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose GraphTrafficGPT, a novel graph-based architecture, which fundamentally redesigns the task coordination process for LLM-driven traffic applications.

arxiv-2509-25295.title: Calibrated Counterfactual Conformal Fairness ( 𝑪 𝟑 ​ 𝑭 \bm{C^{3}F} ): Post-hoc, Shift-Aware Coverage Parity via Conformal Prediction and Counterfactual Regularization
arxiv-2509-25295.creator: Faruk Alpay, Taylan Alpay, [4pt] Lightcap, Department of Bias alpay@lightcap.ai
arxiv-2509-25295.description: Abstract We introduce Calibrated Counterfactual Conformal Fairness (C3F), a post-hoc wrapper for predictive systems that targets group-conditional coverage parity under covariate shift. The procedure combines (i) group- and feature-conditional conformal prediction with importance-weighted quantile calibration and (ii) a counterfactual regularizer based on path-specific effects in a structural causal model.

pmc-10574153.creator: Radu Cercel, Andreea Androne, Cristina Stefania Florica, Adam Lőrinczi, Constantin Serbschi, Mihaela Baibarac
pmc-10574153.description: In this work, applications of nanohybrid composites based on titanium dioxide (TiO2) with anatase crystallin phase and single-walled carbon nanohorns (SWCNHs) as promising catalysts for the photodegradation of amoxicillin (AMOX) are reported. pmc-11433042.title: Lifestyle Factors, Sociodemographic Characteristics and Incident Hypertension: A Prospective Analysis of the Korean National Health Insurance Service Sample Cohort
pmc-11433042.creator: Jung-Eun Lee, Anthony Kityo, Sang-Ah Lee
pmc-11433042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Hypertension is a significant chronic disease globally, and lifestyle modifications are crucial for the prevention of this disease. We conducted a longitudinal analysis of the associations between lifestyle factors and the incidence of hypertension, stratified by sociodemographic characteristics. Methods: We analyzed 113,022 adults (65,315 men), aged 20 years or older from the Korean National Health Insurance Service-National Sample Cohort 2.0 who participated in health screening between 2002 and 2003.

pmc-12468225.title: Sleep Problems and Quality of Life in Breast Cancer Patients
pmc-12468225.creator: Andreas Hinz, Michael Friedrich, Thomas Schulte, Mareike Ernst, Ana N Tibubos, Katja Petrowski, Nadja Dornhöfer
pmc-12468225.description: Simple SummaryIt is well known that breast cancer patients often suffer from sleep problems. These problems have a negative impact on patients’ quality of life. It therefore remains unclear to what extent the study results can be generalized.

pmc-13008932.title: Intrahepatic ectopic atypical parathyroid tumor causing primary hyperparathyroidism: a case report
pmc-13008932.creator: Yuanzheng Ding, Weichao Li, Junkai Li, Zhiwei Zhang, Yuli Gao, Bo Yuan, Caixia Cheng, Jing Liu
pmc-13008932.description: Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) most commonly arises from cervical parathyroid pathology, with ectopic disease representing a rare entity. We report a case of PHPT diagnosed during fracture workup in a female patient who manifested persistent hypercalcemia and elevated parathyroid hormone (PTH) despite two prior cervical explorations.

pmc-13095839.title: Selective anticancer activity of Vachellia nilotica fruit extract: integrated phytochemistry with antioxidant, antimicrobial, and cancer cell targeting
pmc-13095839.creator: Essam Y. Abdul-Hafeez, Omer H. M. Ibrahim, Hani A. Alfheeaid, Hassan Barakat
pmc-13095839.description: IntroductionVachellia nilotica has long been employed in traditional medicine for its therapeutic value. pmc-13429586.title: Oromandibular dystonia unresponsive to botulinum toxin: two illustrative cases of condylar dislocation as a structural mimic
pmc-13429586.creator: Olcay Şakar, Berk Bilgen, Bora Edim Akalın, Kazuya Yoshida
pmc-13429586.description: Botulinum toxin therapy is a mainstay treatment for oromandibular dystonia (OMD), but lack of response should prompt reconsideration of both the injection strategy and the underlying diagnosis. Long-standing condylar dislocation is a structural disorder that can mimic OMD by producing mandibular deviation, impaired mandibular closure, dysarthria, dysphagia, and abnormal jaw or tongue movements.

pmc-13462918.title: Making microbes matter: evidence for the use of digital storytelling in antimicrobial resistance public engagement
pmc-13462918.creator: Becky McCall, Andrew Hayward, Michael Lang, Michael Wilson, Kate Grailey, Laura Shallcross
pmc-13462918.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a major global health threat, yet public engagement remains limited because AMR is often perceived as distant and abstract. Digital storytelling (DST) may offer a more accessible approach by situating AMR within lived experience. In this qualitative study, eight members of the public participated in a facilitated screening discussion of five digital stories (short videos created by people depicting their experiences of resistant infection and antibiotic-related harm).

pmc-13623267.creator: Diego Berlingeri Collazo, Lester Cintron Perez, Emmanuel Torres Troche, Sanjay Vora
pmc-13623267.description: An octogenarian woman with Merkel cell carcinoma of the right upper arm, staged as Stage IIIA at initial diagnosis, underwent wide local excision with sentinel lymph node biopsy followed by adjuvant radiation therapy. She later developed regional nodal recurrence requiring axillary dissection, which was confirmed by biopsy as metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma, requiring axillary dissection.

uslaw-usc-t15-s78j3.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 2B (Securities Exchanges). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Independence of compensation committees (1) Listing standards The Commission shall, by rule, direct the national securities exchanges and national securities associations to prohibit the listing of any equity security of an issuer, other than an issuer that is a controlled company, limited partnership, company.

uslaw-usc-t16-s610.title: 16 U.S.C. § 610 — Permits to cut and remove timber; citizens of Washington County and Kane County, Utah
uslaw-usc-t16-s610.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s610.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 4 (Protection Of Timber, And Depredations). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It shall be lawful for the Secretary of the Interior to grant permits under the provisions of section 607 of this title, to citizens of Washington County and of Kane County, Utah, to cut timber on the public lands of the counties of Mohave.
